fieldNotes.location: Resolved with medium confidence. UNFI Richburg DC sits in the L&C Distribution Park, Richburg SC 29729 (directories give 578 / 578B L&C Distribution Park; the adjacent building 546 L&C Distribution Park is a separately-listed ~110,000 sq ft warehouse). The roster's APPROXIMATE geocode landed in the rural town center ~1.7km NW; the L&C Distribution Park industrial cluster is off Old Richburg Rd E near a highway. The audited building (locked ~34.70980,-81.00420) is the warehouse in this park whose layout - a dock bank with canopies and a trailer-parking apron - is most consistent with a UNFI conventional-grocery satellite DC. Could not get UNFI signage in Street View (panos snap to the highway, not the park access road), so building identity within the multi-tenant park is not 100% certain.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Uncertain - no controlled gate visible at the audited building; the truck yard and dock apron appear open to the L&C Distribution Park internal road. No barrier arm or booth seen at z19. Listed uncertain because Street View could not corroborate the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: None visible. remoteGs left false (no confirmed gate).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~20 doors estimated - a dock bank with a row of dark dock canopies on the building's west face, several trailers backed in; band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 - paved trailer apron alongside the dock bank holds parked trailers; modest drop capacity for a regional satellite DC.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - parked trailers staged on the apron separate from active dock positions.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal park road and yard give a deep approach; a multi-truck queue could form inside the park without spilling to a public road.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - small-town SC industrial park (Richburg) ringed by woodland; an exurban Charlotte-region DC.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~9 acres estimated for the audited building's parcel; the L&C park as a whole is larger.

citations.claim: UNFI's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties, lists a distribution centre at "Richburg, South Carolina" as of 2025-08-02. Our roster address for this record is "Richburg, SC".

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

sources.covers: UNFI network optimisation, the Allentown PA closure, and Central-region consolidations

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Richburg, South Carolina as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
